title: Export frozen inputs from an explicit historical commit
body:
Research-package exports can now use an explicit historical input commit. `--ref` supplies the unchanged package; the opt-in `--input-ref` supplies all external declared inputs and their executable modes. Both exact commits appear in the receipt and CLI result. Default single-commit export bytes remain unchanged. This is a replay/tooling feature, with no change to the complete kappa calculation.

The [implementation](https://github.com/aliromman/integer-mult-bounds/blob/758369f275ced2d628a579a12ac32344708bd186/scripts/export_research_package.py), [real Git regression fixtures](https://github.com/aliromman/integer-mult-bounds/blob/758369f275ced2d628a579a12ac32344708bd186/tests/test_research_export_input_ref.py) and [usage contract](https://github.com/aliromman/integer-mult-bounds/blob/758369f275ced2d628a579a12ac32344708bd186/docs/research/package-export.md) define the boundary. A declared input inside the package is rejected in this mode because the contexts would conflict. A missing historical input or invalid ref fails before publication. Historical inputs may be absent from the publication tree and working checkout. Both source contexts retain the existing immutable-object, path, mode and atomic-output safeguards; offline checks validate the optional exact input-commit label.

This addresses a reproduced failure in the [order-21 group-algebra package](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/blob/1ec1119972c9aefe42525172d07b332fcff81cb4/research/bit-semidir21-orbit-seed8f89/README.md), whose [unchanged source manifest](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/blob/1ec1119972c9aefe42525172d07b332fcff81cb4/research/bit-semidir21-orbit-seed8f89/SOURCES.json) pins the common base `1c47876ef742ba64bf9140b0527d63acf656a3b4`. Exporting its current publication with current inputs passes transport checks but its source-pin preflight rejects the changed selected record. Exporting the same package with its historical input commit passes all three declared-input SHA256/Git-blob checks and the original arithmetic verifier, without editing a source pin or checkout file. The [scoped claim](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/discussions/4578#discussioncomment-19154604) records this tooling question.

With both exact commits available, run from the repository root using Python 3.12 and the standard library:

```sh
python3 -B scripts/export_research_package.py export --package research/bit-semidir21-orbit-seed8f89 --ref 1ec1119972c9aefe42525172d07b332fcff81cb4 --input-ref 1c47876ef742ba64bf9140b0527d63acf656a3b4 --output /tmp/semidir21-historical-inputs.tar
python3 -B scripts/export_research_package.py check /tmp/semidir21-historical-inputs.tar
python3 -B -W error -m unittest discover -s tests -p 'test_research_export*.py'
python3 -B -W error -m unittest discover -s tests -p test_research_git_replacements.py
```

Expected: `PASS_RESEARCH_EXPORT` with both commits and 10 files, and test `OK`. Local CPython 3.12.13 checks pass all 26 exporter tests and six shared replacement-ref tests. Optimized exporter checks pass. After extracting the trusted archive into a fresh Git-free directory, the unchanged optimized verifier prints `PASS_SEMIDIRECT21_THREE_REGISTER` and reproduces 560 calls, 313600 ordered pairs, 258581 products and its original exact digest. The current-input archive fails the independent declared-input source-pin check. The original direct arithmetic verifier passes in both contexts because it does not enforce those external pins itself; the registered runner enforces them. Those mathematical counts belong to the original package; they are not new results here. The committed-diff planner selects zero research packages, and `git diff --check` passes.

This option selects one common input tree, not arbitrary mixed source commits. It does not infer the correct input ref, verify scientific compatibility, authenticate Git ancestry, install dependencies, make Git-dependent verifiers portable or weaken a package's source guards. The receipt remains transport integrity; the direct scientific replay is separate. No whole-supplier, selected native, Lean, Docker or full-history replay was run.

Base: `1ec1119972c9aefe42525172d07b332fcff81cb4`. Credit Tekalign's [PR3138](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/3138) exporter, roger-sato's retained path/object safeguards, Mihir Srivastava's portable fixtures and Dennis's [explicit historical-replay helper](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/blob/1ec1119972c9aefe42525172d07b332fcff81cb4/scripts/replay_historical_check.py). The order-21 result was prepared by OpenAI Codex at Cinna's direction, as its source notice states. New feature and tests: Ali Romman with substantial OpenAI Codex assistance; Apache-2.0.
